title: A characterization of the von Neumann and Morgenstern stable set in matching markets
abstract: arXiv:2607.00869v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies the structure and computation of von Neumann-Morgenstern (vNM) stable sets in one-to-one matching markets. While pairwise stability and corewise stability coincide under strict preferences and provide a well-understood benchmark, vNM stability is defined through dominance relations among sets of matchings and remains considerably more difficult to characterize. A key contribution of the paper is a generalization of the classical Decomposition Lemma. We show that the structural decomposition traditionally used to compare stable matchings extends to any pair of matchings belonging to the same internally stable set. This result reveals a previously unexplored connection between internal stability and the cycle structure underlying matching markets. Building on this characterization, we identify the relationships that are relevant for dominance-based stability and derive a reduced environment that concentrates all undo

translated_title: 匹配市场中冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦稳定集的刻画
translated_abstract: 本文研究一对一匹配市场中冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦稳定集的结构与计算问题。在严格偏好下，两两稳定性和核心稳定性相一致，并提供了已被充分理解的基准；而vNM稳定性则是通过匹配集合之间的支配关系来定义的，其刻画仍然相当困难。本文的一个关键贡献是对经典分解引理的推广。我们证明，传统上用于比较稳定匹配的结构性分解可以推广到属于同一内部稳定集的任意一对匹配。这一结果揭示了内部稳定性与匹配市场底层循环结构之间此前未被探索的联系。基于这一刻画，我们识别了与基于支配关系的稳定性相关的匹配关系，并推导出一个浓缩了所有……
tldr: 该论文将经典分解引理推广至同一内部稳定集中的任意匹配对，从而刻画了一对一匹配市场中冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦稳定集的结构，并揭示了内部稳定性与匹配市场循环结构之间的新联系。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes the von Neumann-Morgenstern stable set in one-to-one matching markets by generalizing the classical Decomposition Lemma to any pair of matchings within the same internally stable set, revealing a novel connection between internal stability and the cycle structure of matching markets.
